items.html: And we shall now explain the matter of this fifth aspect, which are the true inner Mochin of ZA; and through it will be explained why only three Mochin were made. Behold, we explained above that all these aspects exist together, all of them. And [this is] from the fourth aspect, which is the true surrounding light of the whole head of ZA, when they are above, outside the NHY of the upper Ima, as above.
